units.source_text: 天色愈来愈亮，柏木心慌意乱，又对她说道：

en.t: As the sky grew brighter and brighter, Kashiwagi, anxious and distraught, said to her again:

units.source_text: “我昨夜做了一个可怕的梦，正想讲给你听。

en.t: Last night I had a terrible dream, and I was just about to tell you about it.

units.source_text: 但你如此嫌恶我，我也无心讲了。

en.t: But since you detest me so much, I no longer have the heart to speak of it.

units.source_text: 我已悟得这个梦的意义了。”

en.t: I have already understood the meaning of that dream.

units.source_text: 匆匆欲行之人，觉得苍茫的曙色比秋日的天空更加凄凉。

en.t: To the man who was hurrying to leave, the vast, dim light of dawn seemed even more desolate than the autumn sky.
